Working closely with Engineering, you’ll ensure the platform runs seamlessly across devices, regions, and releases, setting the standard for quality, reliability, and user experience. You'll split your time between hands-on QA work and leading the QA engineers in the QA chapter: helping them grow in their craft, spreading good practice, and raising the bar for quality across the teams you work with. A key part of this role will be driving smarter, more scalable testing approaches, including AI-driven testing and automation. Foster a strong quality culture across teams by embedding QA best practices early and tying quality goals to product velocity and platform reliability. Drive innovation through AI-driven testing and predictive approaches to identify risks earlier, improve coverage, and reduce manual effort. Partner with development, design, and product teams to integrate QA best practices early in the release cycle. Design and maintain comprehensive test plans and automated suites for key user flows (login, payments, live events, notifications, etc.). Lead, mentor, and scale the QA team — setting up clear processes, code quality standards, and testing frameworks. Implement automation and regression testing strategies using tools such as Maestro, Espresso, XCTest, Appium, or similar frameworks. Use contract testing (e.g., Pact) to validate backend and service integrations. Apply performance and reliability testing across mobile platforms to ensure smooth user experiences. Job Requirements 5+ years of experience in QA for mobile apps or platforms, including at least 2 years leading teams. Proven ability to design scalable QA processes in fast-paced, development-heavy environments. Strong experience with automation frameworks, regression testing, and CI/CD pipelines. Hands-on experience with mobile debugging tools (Android Studio, Xcode) and network analysis tools like Charles. Strong understanding of how to build a quality-first mindset across engineering and product teams. Interest in or experience with AI-assisted testing and new QA technologies. Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and a user-first mindset. Familiarity with project and documentation tools such as Jira and Notion. About us Come join the team building the engine behind rewarded mobile gaming – making playtime truly rewarding. At JustPlay, we’re on a mission to power a fairer, more sustainable rewarded gaming ecosystem where users earn real value for their time through a self-sustaining modell. Since launching in 2020, we’ve grown into one of the world’s leading rewarded gaming platforms, with 25M+ downloads and 500K+ daily active users. Headquartered in Berlin and backed by NCSoft, one of the world’s leading gaming companies, we continue to operate fully independently – combining the speed, ownership, and ambition of a startup with the long-term backing of a global gaming powerhouse. With a team across 20+ countries, we’re shaping a major shift in mobile gaming – and it’s still early enough for you to make your mark. At JustPlay, you’ll build end-to-end, move fast, and ship work that reaches millions – in a company that’s profitable, built to last, and focused on outcomes over hype.
